footer.mode.animatedHint:
Current: Animated. Your characters cast each planned spell as a normal in-game action, one after another, spending their own slots, uses and charges. A failed or interrupted cast stops the run.
Click to switch to Instant.
footer.mode.instantHint:
Current: Instant. Each planned casting resolves at once through the game's own spell rules and spends the same slots, uses and charges as casting by hand. A casting with no supported instant route is not ready in this mode, and a failed cast stops the run.
Click to switch to Animated.
footer.policy.availableHint:
Current: Cast available (default). Running a routine casts the planned castings that are available and affordable, in saved order, and the game log names each casting it omits. Already-active and disabled castings behave as before.
Click to switch to Require full.
footer.policy.fullHint:
Current: Require full. When you run a routine, every needed planned casting is checked first; if any is unavailable, nothing is cast and the game log names what blocked it. This is a check before casting, not an undo if a cast fails later.
Click to switch to Cast available.

persistence.classic.loadBackup: Your saved planner setup file was missing, so its latest readable backup was loaded.
persistence.classic.loadNoBackup: Your saved planner setup file was missing and its backups could not be read, so a new setup is shown. Saving works, but it replaces those backups in turn - move them out of UserSettings to keep them.
persistence.classic.loadProtectedBackup: Your saved planner setup could not be read, so its latest backup was loaded. The unreadable file was left unchanged; changes are not saved while it is there - move it aside to save here.
persistence.classic.loadUnreadable: Your saved planner setup could not be read or comes from a newer planner. It was left unchanged and a new setup is shown; changes are not saved while that file is there - move it aside to save here.
persistence.classic.saveRefused: Not saved: the saved planner setup for this campaign could not be read or comes from a newer planner. It was left unchanged; move it aside to save here.
persistence.load.backup: Your casting plan file was missing, so its latest backup was loaded.
persistence.load.blocked: Your casting plan could not be read or comes from a newer planner, so nothing was loaded from it and saving is blocked. It was left unchanged: move that file out of UserSettings, then press Reload - the newest readable backup is then loaded, or the planner starts over.
persistence.load.blockedFiles: Your casting plan could not be read or comes from a newer planner ({0}), so nothing was loaded from it and saving is blocked. It was left unchanged: move those files out of UserSettings, then press Reload - the newest readable backup is then loaded, or the planner starts over.
persistence.load.protectedBackup: Your casting plan could not be read, so its latest backup was loaded. The unreadable file was left unchanged; saving is refused while it is there - move it aside to save here.
persistence.review.protected: Plan accepted for this session only: the saved review file could not be read or comes from a newer planner, and was left unchanged.
persistence.review.saveFailed: Plan accepted for this session only: the review could not be saved.
persistence.save.failed: Not saved: the plan could not be written.
persistence.save.importBlocked: Not saved: your classic plan could not be imported, and nothing is saved until it is. Repair or restore it, then press Reload.
persistence.save.loadBlocked: Not saved: your casting plan file could not be read or comes from a newer planner. Move it and its backups (.bak1 to .bak3) out of UserSettings, then press Reload.
persistence.save.otherCampaign: Not saved: the plan file for this campaign holds another campaign's plan. It was left unchanged.
persistence.save.protected: Not saved: the plan file could not be read or comes from a newer planner. It was left unchanged; move it aside to save here.
reason.ability-targeting-unsupported: this buff's targeting is not supported
reason.caster-not-in-party: the caster is not in the party
reason.effect-owner-not-readable: a required effect owner is outside the readable party and pets; this casting cannot be confirmed
reason.effect-owner-unresolved: a required effect owner could not be determined; refresh after nearby units move
reason.enhancement-balance-unknown: the required enhancement's remaining uses could not be read
reason.enhancement-changes-targeting: an enhancement that changes whom the spell reaches (such as Share Transmutation) - remove it and use "Share with an ally" before choosing the target
reason.enhancement-exhausted: a required enhancement has no uses remaining
reason.enhancement-incompatible: an enhancement does not fit this casting
reason.enhancement-pool-exhausted: not enough required enhancement uses after earlier planned castings
reason.enhancement-pool-unknown: the required enhancement's resource pool is unavailable
reason.enhancements-unvalidated: an enhancement could not be checked
reason.exact-source-ambiguous: the caster can cast it in more than one way; pick the exact spell or item
reason.import.caster: the old plan let the planner pick any caster; choose one
reason.import.exact: the old plan used one exact source; check it
reason.import.group: the old plan cast this on a group; check where it is centred and who it reaches
reason.import.optional: the old plan allowed an optional enhancement; check which one
reason.import.recipient: the old plan named no recipient; choose one
reason.import.required: the old plan required an enhancement; check which one
reason.import.shape: the old plan did not say single target or group; choose
reason.import.shapeNamed: the old plan did not say single target or group (it named {0}); choose
reason.import.source: the old plan named a source but no caster; choose the caster
reason.instant.animated: it needs a normal animated cast
reason.instant.combined: its enhancements need a normal cast together
reason.instant.enhancement: a chosen enhancement needs a normal cast
reason.instant.touch: its touch delivery needs a normal cast
reason.instantUnavailable: it cannot be cast instantly ({0}); switch the mode to Animated to cast it, or remove it
reason.insufficient-shared-resource: remaining shared uses are required by earlier planned castings
reason.item.Ambiguous: identical copies of its item are equipped; use Change caster/source and click the copy to use
reason.item.Invalid: its saved item selection is unreadable; use Change caster/source to choose a current source
reason.item.LegacyFact: saved by an older version that could not remember its item; use Change caster/source and click the item once
reason.item.Missing: its saved item is not equipped on this caster; use Change caster/source to choose a current source
reason.item.SlotEmpty: its saved equipment slot no longer holds this item; use Change caster/source to choose a current copy
reason.material-unavailable: not enough material components after earlier planned castings
reason.no-eligible-prepared-token: the selected prepared uses are required by earlier planned castings
reason.origin-anchor-illegal: the group spell cannot be centred there
reason.origin-caster-illegal: the group spell cannot be centred on its caster; centre it on a party member
reason.predicted-coverage-empty: no party member would be reached
reason.present-effect-not-sufficient: the active effect is weaker or about to expire
reason.provider-option-unavailable: the caster cannot cast it right now
reason.refusal.anchor: choose the unit the group spell is centred on first.
reason.refusal.casterOrigin: a caster-centred group spell is centred on its caster.
reason.refusal.directTarget: a single-target casting has no group area; switch to group targeting for that.
reason.refusal.exact: that character can cast it in more than one way; pick one under Cast from.
reason.refusal.first: it is already cast first in its routine.
reason.refusal.groupTarget: a group casting has no single recipient; switch to a single target to pick one.
reason.refusal.incomplete: this casting is not complete yet.
reason.refusal.last: it is already cast last in its routine.
reason.refusal.levelAmbiguous: that character knows this spell at more than one level in the same spellbook, and this version cannot pick one of them; cast it another way.
reason.refusal.mode: this buff cannot be cast that way.
reason.refusal.noParty: the party could not be read; close and reopen the planner.
reason.refusal.readyCaster: choose who casts it before marking it Ready.
reason.refusal.readyReview: review what the import changed before marking it Ready.
reason.refusal.recipient: choose who receives this casting first.
reason.refusal.single: choose who receives it to switch back to a single target.
reason.refusal.unavailableProvider: that character can no longer cast this buff that way.
reason.refusal.unusable: that character cannot cast this buff.
reason.share-feature-unavailable: the caster does not have Share Transmutation
reason.share-no-legal-recipient: no legal ally to share it with
reason.share-not-needed: this spell can already target others
reason.share-source-not-supported: Share Transmutation does not support this exact spell

reason.share-unverified-caster: the sharing caster could not be verified
reason.source-unresolvable: the buff's source was not found
reason.target-mode-mismatch: the buff cannot be cast this way
reason.target-not-friendly: the recipient is not an ally
reason.target-not-in-party: the recipient is not in the party

reason.targeting-modifier-unavailable: a required targeting modifier is not available
